name: Classic Swizzle Skating
description: Symmetric rhythmic swizzle gait on passive roller wheels, generating forward propulsion without lifting feet off the ground.
details: Emulates human inline skating swizzles (hourglass foot patterns). Uses continuous lateral leg splaying and converging arcs to convert leg extension forces into forward rolling momentum without foot lift-off. Trained in mjlab using full roller wheel contacts.

verification.summary: Verified in MuJoCo Warp / mjlab simulation over 4096 parallel environments with BAM actuator friction physics.
verification.notes: Targeted for smooth surfaces like wood or polished concrete where passive wheel friction is minimal. Artifact URL is dead (upstream moved); no vendored bytes available, so the verified_simulation tier was decayed. Re-vendor the ONNX (sha256 + size) to restore the tier.

contract.actuator_model: Dynamixel XL330 (BAM M6 voltage control law)
